notes.title: Big Demo Update
notes.notes:
I've been working on the new look of the game for a very long time. Now you can play the updated demo, new story details, updated sound and gameplay mechanics, completely updated event location. Enjoy the vhs camera effect that will immerse you in the atmosphere with your head. 

Yes, it will probably be scary, but you'll get through it. The gameplay duration of the demo version is max. [b]15 min. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788386/7272672c2b2e22939d1436be0f8a0dde511320fd.png[/img]

I want to inform you that news about the game is released on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@WhoAmIRemedy]youtube channel[/url]. 

Also the optimization has been improved and I hope your iron horses will handle the game without problems.

notes.title: BUGS FIXED
notes.notes: There was a bug in the room with the Violin, now it fixed, so you won't have any problems while playing. Let me know if you find somthing else. Thank you.

notes.title: DEMO VERSION IS OUT!
notes.notes: I'm happy to inform you that the demo is now available on Steam. I wish you a nice game and of course I'm waiting for your feedback, because it's important for me to know your opinion, let's make a good game together!

notes.title: Demo is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, this month I'm ready to present you a demo of the game. You will see the concept of Who Am I: Remedy and part of the story. In the next announcement I will notify you about the demo release!

Best Regards

notes.title: Hello, Detectives!
notes.notes:
The game now has a page in the store, which means that I will keep you informed about all updates and stages of the game's development. In advance I would like to thank everyone who has already added the game to their [b]wishlist[/b]. 

I would like to inform you that the [b]demo version[/b] will be available at the beginning of January, so that everyone can play and evaluate the game for themselves. The planned [b]release date[/b] is at the beginnig of March, I don't want to rush and release a raw, unfinished product, [b]all in good time[/b].

Also at the moment most of the [b]gameplay mechanics[/b] are ready, which will help you to fully immerse yourself in the game. The development of the storyline has already started, the goal for today is to create a lively story.

Thank you all for your attention, I will be back soon with more news!
